subject: problem with simplex unconstrain in stan/io/writer.hpp?

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: problem with simplex unconstrain in stan/io/writer.hpp?
parts:
I am testing transforming parameters between unconstrained space and constrained space using a simplex parameter.  But I got problems when I do the following since I cannot get back (A and A* are different):

A ---> B (to constrained space)
B ---> A* (to unconstrained space)


The problem I think lies in function simplex_unconstrain in stan/io/writer.hpp, in which a different approached than the inverse is used. 

--
Jiqiang

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] problem with simplex unconstrain in stan/io/writer.hpp?
parts:
You're absolutely right. I should've been calling
simplex_free within the writer.

I'll push a test and fix ASAP.

- Bob
